pitchEmail.subject: Community Partnership Opportunity for Jeremy Peña fans
pitchEmail.body: Dear community leaders, I am reaching out to discuss a potential partnership centered around the local fanbase of Jeremy Peña. We are organizing a blood drive at the Julia Ideson Building in Houston to support patients in our city. As many Jeremy Peña fans are passionate about athleticism and team spirit, we believe this is a perfect opportunity for the community to come together for a life-saving cause. Our campaign aims to reach 300 donors by December 13, with a kickoff event on November 14. We would love to collaborate to encourage fans to check their eligibility and participate. Please let us know if you would be interested in helping us promote this initiative among local supporters.
